description: Create a new FOIA (Freedom of Information Act) request complaint in ArkCase. Log in as arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com (password: ArkCase1234!), navigate to the Complaints module using the left sidebar, click '+ New' then 'Complaint'. Set the Complaint Title to 'Pesticide Registration Review Documents for Glyphosate - EPA-HQ-OPP-2009-0361'. Set the Incident Category to 'Government' and Priority to 'Medium'. In the Complaint Description, enter: 'FOIA request from Natural Resources Defense Council for all pesticide registration review documents, risk assessments, and internal communications related to Glyphosate review under EPA-HQ-OPP-2009-0361.' Click 'Save Complaint' to save.
